scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@leadboard/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@leadboard/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,backend,frontend "npm run dev -w @leadboard/contracts" "npm run dev -w @leadboard/backend" "npm run dev -w @leadboard/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @leadboard/contracts && npm run dev -w @leadboard/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @leadboard/contracts && npm run dev -w @leadboard/frontend
